text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty/auto-page fired: NODE_ALERT host=gpu-node-73 severity=SEV_P0 reason=kernel_watchdog_reset + kubelet NotReady. Automatic fanout to on-call rota. link: https://pd.example.com/incidents/INC-7321 :rotating_light:

sam_oncall: acked. I'm taking. Checking serial console and SSH now. @maya_eng @ryan_ops FYI.

maya_eng: thanks Sam. quick context: gpu-node-73 (rack-r12-u3) currently running inference pool for tenant:neon-ai. Seen a slow ramp earlier but no prior crashes today.

ryan_ops: I can try serial attach if you need; might be nvlink watchdog or kernel oops. DM me if you want me to power-cycle via iLO.

sam_oncall: attaching serial now, may take ~30s. running `kubectl get nodes gpu-node-73 -o wide` shows `STATUS: NotReady`, `KERNEL: watchdog-reset`.

sam_oncall: serial dump shows repeated messages: `NMI: watchdog: GPU0 hung - resetting` then `kernel: BUG: soft lockup - CPU#3 stuck for 22s`. pasted tail: ```
[ 1234.567890] nvrm: Xid (PCIe) 79, pid 0: GPU hang detected
[ 1234.568012] watchdog: BUG: soft lockup - CPU#3
```

tess_sre: that's an Xid79 pattern we saw on older driver builds. Are we on the new 520 driver on that rack? `rpm -q nvidia-driver` on the host (if you can get in).

sam_oncall: can't SSH, serial is readable though. host is running driver `nvidia-510.68` per image banner. looks like this machine missed the rolling upgrade last week.

maya_eng: impact check: traffic routing shows ~5 active GRPC streams hitting that node, 2 active customer jobs (tenant:neon-ai job ids: `neon-2211`, `neon-2217`). Latency alarms triggered for `neon-ai`'s realtime route 2m ago. Support ticket auto-created.

ali_support: support here. I've notified account exec and put a banner in the customer dashboard: "Degraded inference latency for neon-ai, investigating". Will escalate if RMA required.

ryan_ops: propose we cordon and drain the node to evacuate pods, then mark for RMA if it reboots into same state. But if kubelet is NotReady and drain hangs, we should force-delete pods and rely on routing fallback.

sam_oncall: trying `kubectl cordon gpu-node-73` ... cordoned. `kubectl drain gpu-node-73 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force --grace-period=30` -> drain is stuck at evicting `inference-deploy-rc` (eviction pending). Kubelet offline so eviction isn't completing.

tess_sre: ok that matches kubelet unreachable. Do not `kubectl delete node` yet. Two mitigation paths: 1) power cycle via BMC to force reboot (may clear GPU watchdog) 2) reroute traffic at front proxy to avoid that rack. Which do you prefer?

sam_oncall: I'm going to request BMC power cycle now. @ryan_ops please coordinate. I'm also adding a temporary routing rule to drop the node at the LB layer so new requests don't land there.

ryan_ops: initiating remote power-cycle via IPMI -> `ipmitool -I lanplus -H bmc-r12-u3 -U admin -P **** chassis power cycle`. BMC responded; node is powering off. ETA ~90s.

incident-bot: PD incident INC-7321 updated: acknowledged by sam_oncall. Severity remains P0. Current responders: sam_oncall, ryan_ops, maya_eng, tess_sre, ali_support.

sam_oncall: node came back, but kernel log shows same Xid79 during boot and kubelet flaps back to NotReady. Reboot didn't fix.

maya_eng: given repeated Xid79 on 510 driver, I'm recommending we fail over workloads to a compatible spare rack and isolate gpu-node-73 for RMA/driver-reimage. I'll open a ticket for patching to 520 drivers for that rack.

ryan_ops: I've marked node `unschedulable` and added `node.kubernetes.io/unavailable=true` annotation for routing. K8s still has 2 pods stuck; I'll force-delete them: `kubectl delete pod <pod> --grace-period=0 --force` (doing now). Pods recreated on node pool backups.

ali_support: customer note: `neon-ai` jobs `neon-2211`/`2217` retried and are now running on replacement nodes; notifying customer of degraded window ~12:43-12:56 UTC and that jobs resumed.

tess_sre: postmortem action items (temporary): 1) Mark rack-r12-u3 as driver-pinning exception until upgrade. 2) Add a preflight check in rollout to detect 510->520 mismatches. 3) Improve drain tooling to fallback to force-delete when kubelet unreachable.

sam_oncall: switching to handoff mode in 15m. I'll leave a short doc in the incident tracker with commands attempted and serial logs. @tess_sre if you want to own follow-up RMA/driver patch, please take.

tess_sre: taking follow-up. adding to board. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident INC-7321 status updated to MONITORING (on-call handoff scheduled). Closed responders: sam_oncall (primary), ryan_ops (ops), maya_eng (eng), tess_sre (follow-up), ali_support (support). Log link: https://incidents.example.com/INC-7321/logs

sam_oncall: handing off. last note: watch for similar Xid79 spikes in r12 racks over next 24h.

ali_support: will keep customer-facing comms open and update SLA page.
